decision.summary: A sharp, multi-axis (E/U) drop initiates near index 530 with no observed reversal within the allowed context (490–570). E and U remain offset at lower levels through index 569; N is minimally affected. Because the return is unobserved and the interior is sustained without recovery, the interval is classified as uncertain—consistent with either a permanent step or a long-duration temporary offset.

intervals.observation: E and U show a sharp co-drop starting near index 530 (E from ~21 to ~7 MAD, U from ~12 to ~2 MAD); N shows only a minor dip (~28.5 to ~28.0 MAD). No return is observed within allowed_context [490,570]; the offset persists to the end of the window. Interior behavior is sustained (flat/low-noise) after the drop, but absence of recovery prevents confirmation of temporary nature.
